title: Settler violence surges in the West Bank
summary: As the Iran-Israel-US-Lebanon war makes headlines around the world, what is happening in the occupied West Bank? contentText: As the Iran-Israel-US-Lebanon war makes headlines around the world, what is happening in the occupied West Bank? Expropriation of Palestinian land, settler attacks and killings have long been the story of the West Bank, but human rights campaigners and experts say that amid the fog of regional war, attacks are on the rise and Israeli settlers are emboldened. We take a closer look in this special edition of Middle East Matters.
